title: Legislative districts of Eastern Samar

{{Use mdy dates|date=December 2022}} {{Use Philippine English|date=December 2022}} {{Politics of the Philippines}} The '''legislative districts of Eastern Samar''' are the representations of the [[Provinces of the Philippines|province]] of [[Eastern Samar]] in the [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|various national legislatures]] of the [[Philippines]]. The province is currently represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the [[Congress of the Philippines]] through its [[#Lone District|lone congressional district]]. == History == [[Eastern Samar]] was represented as the [[Legislative districts of Samar#1907–1969 3|third district]] of [[Samar]] until Republic Act No. 4221{{cite web | url=http://laws.chanrobles.com/ph/ra/republicactno4221.html | title=PHILIPPINE LAWS, STATUTES and CODES }} was ratified in November 1965, after which the representative of the third district of Samar automatically served as Eastern Samar's representative. It was part of the representation of [[Interim Batasang Pambansa|Region VIII]] from 1978 to 1984. == Lone District == *'''Population (2015)''': 467,160{{Cite web |title=TABLE 1.
